name: prompting-wizard
description: Learn prompting through your everyday work: practice, short lessons and Learning Cards, an optional 30-lesson course, and a review of your past chats.

interface.longDescription: Prompting Wizard helps people who write prompts at work get better at it while doing real tasks. Finish a task, then choose practice, an example or a short lesson built from it, and keep the evidence you accept in a portable Learning Card that you can bring to a new chat. Take the optional 30-lesson course, or supply a data export of your past chats from this app to see where prompts cost you extra turns. Limitations: in a chat app nothing is stored between chats, so attach your Learning Card or course progress file to continue; only exports you choose to supply are reviewed; learning outcomes have not yet been established through testing with learners.
defaultPrompt: Use Prompting Wizard to teach me through my work; no interview.
Review my past chats with Prompting Wizard.
